issue.title: S19 · Names are unique in a room
issue.body:
**PRD ID:** S19 · **Threat IDs:** T-S6
### Summary
Look-alike names let someone pass as a friend (T-S6).
### Acceptance (the attack fails)
While "Sam" is in the room, "sam", "SAM", "Ｓａｍ" and " Sam " are refused with "Someone in this room is already called Sam". No name is suggested. Names with a zero-width space, a text-direction override or Latin mixed with Cyrillic ("Ѕam") are refused, following UTS #39 "Highly Restrictive". Edge: "Sam M" and "山田さくら" are allowed. Devanagari vowel signs aren't stripped, so different names don't clash. "👩‍👩‍👧" is allowed and counts as one character. Two devices picking "Sam" at once: the time keeper keeps the first.
